Elina, also known as Elani or Elavar, is a Hindu deity worshipped in the southern states of India, particularly Tamil Nadu. She is believed to be the wife of Lord Murugan and the mother of his two children, Kartikeya and Devasena. The legend of Elina is associated with the battle between the gods and the demon king Soorapadman, and she is revered as the goddess of the forest and childbirth.
